summary: Phase 2.1 full validation completed. Backend (33 new + 45 regression = 78/78 PASS). Frontend critical flows all PASS: sidebar nav, Procedimentos CRUD, MinhaClinica sections, login text, public routes (/confirmacao/:token and /upload-mobile) render without redirecting to /login, AttendanceDialog now has exactly 4 tabs (Ficha/Evolução/Prescrição/Assinatura) with no isolated Fotos tab, IMC calculation in Ficha Corporal works in real-time (170/70 → 24.22 / 'Peso normal'), conditional field doencas_descricao appears after marking Diabetes chip, photos-before-uploader and photos-after-uploader present inside Evolução tab, Mobile QR buttons present per ficha, and Agenda pre-registration dialog (open-prereg-btn/prereg-name/prereg-phone) opens correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1700 lines — consider splitting per domain (auth, patients, appointments, procedures, clinic, public, mobile-upload, ai, files, messages) into routers for maintainability.

Public confirmation endpoint POST /public/appointment/{token}/action returns successful payload but the JWT does not enforce single-use; multiple actions (confirm→cancel→reschedule) all succeeded in tests. Consider invalidating token after first non-idempotent action or expiring tighter than appointment date.
Mobile upload JWT is 20-minute lived but /mobile-upload/files/{token} is publicly readable for that window — fine for QR flow, but log access for audit if PHI photos are eventually involved.
CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True which is browser-blocked in production. Acceptable for preview but flag for production hardening (set explicit origins).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed procedures, patients, anamnesis modules during tests; cleaned up via DELETE inside the tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2.1 fully validated. Backend regression file is test_phase2_1_api.py + test_phase2_api.py + test_proclinic_api.py — run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var set. Public routes /confirmacao/:token and /upload-mobile are correctly registered BEFORE ProtectedRoute in App.js. AttendanceDialog now has only 4 main tabs (Fotos removed). Phase 3 (Evolution API WhatsApp send) is not yet implemented — WhatsApp button currently just generates the public link and opens WhatsApp Web window.
